scientific_integrity: Only the sharp Fourier degree lower bound is proposed as new; earlier pure-harmonic covering, orbit classification, and basin scaling are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Necessity requires odd finite Fourier interactions, identical all-to-all positive coupling, and stabilization of every grid coloring. Sufficiency and basin facts follow earlier pure-harmonic covering literature. Historical novelty of the lower bound is assessed from examined sources, not guaranteed.
title: Sharp Fourier-order barrier for universal phase-grid multistability
